units.rawText: There are way too many people who claim to understand my work. Most of them are just panderers trying to show off by claiming they "get it".

units.rawText: They take pictures in front of sculptures, stick their logos on them and post them to social media platforms, but they don't even know the name of the piece on display.

units.rawText: Still, the way you look at exhibitions doesn't seem to be the same as them. Could it be that you have "spirit sight" too? Come, tell me about what you feel about this piece.
